verdict.rationale: Solid's docs emphasize JSX/TypeScript familiarity, real DOM elements, and components as 'just functions' with no new rendering system to learn (solid-gh-9, solid-gh-14, solid-gh-5, solid-gh-15), and some devs confirm an easy transition from React/Vue (solid-comm-4, solid-comm-5, solid-comm-14). However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the 'minimal new concepts' claim: users note the reactivity/API is 'non-intuitive' compared to alternatives and that 'every prop needs to be a function returning a value instead of a plain value, or it won't update reactively' — a real deviation from standard JS/JSX expectations (solid-comm-8, solid-comm-16). missing for 10: no resolution of the prop-as-function friction, no independent tutorial validating a smooth zero-new-concept onboarding.
